notes.title: 8/15 Patch & Maintenance Notice
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the PUBG: BLINDSPOT development team.  

We will be conducting a patch and maintenance to improve the game and resolve issues.  


Maintenance Schedule
 August 15th (Fri.) 10:00 AM ~ 11:00 AM KST (1 hour)


Fixed Issues
 Fixed an issue where some tactical tools were unintentionally blocking explosion damage.

 Fixed an issue where characters would not spawn in certain situations on some maps.

 Fixed duplicate icons used for some weapons.

Important Notice

Game access will be unavailable during the maintenance period. Please restart your Steam app after maintenance is completed to apply the update.

Thank you for your understanding regarding this maintenance for a better gaming environment.


Thank you.

Maintenance Schedule
August 14th (Thr.) 1:00 PM ~ 2:00 PM KST (1 hour)


Patch Notes
Improved the matchmaking system to match players with similar skill levels more effectively.

Fixed an issue where team assignments would occasionally malfunction or teams would have uneven numbers when players joined mid-game.

Improved situations where the key settings menu would malfunction.


Important Notice
Game access will be unavailable during the maintenance period. Please restart your Steam app after maintenance is completed to apply the update.

Thank you for your understanding regarding this maintenance for a better gaming environment.



Thank you.

notes.title: PUBG: BLINDSPOT August Demo Play Patch note
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277077/c522a9463ff8dcf7fa02e514e15ddf094b0b49aa.png"]

Hello Gamers! The demo play - early access finally starts today! 

This update introduces significant system enhancements and exciting new content.



From August 14th, 2 pm (KST) onwards, the game will be available for everyone to play on Steam!



\[Characters] New Character Additions 

4 new characters join the roster: Wilson, Goldberg, Patch, Whistle,

Each features unique weapons and exclusive gadgets for fresh strategic combinations,

 Team-Specific Character System 

Attack Team Exclusive: Apex, Whistle, Buddy, Wilson, Goldberg,

Defense Team Exclusive: Dropout, Fanatic, Collision, Patch, Haze,

Free Pick Characters: Kayak, Zen, Carnival, Clarice,

Enables role-specific tactical gameplay for each team,

\[Ranking System] New Skill-Based Ranking 

Rank changes based on match results,

7-tier ranking system,

Exclusive rewards: rank icons and profile borders,

Test phase for upcoming competitive mode implementation,

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277077/ca2b1961efbf2f3cac279fd3033cc5d28d0c9a9e.png"]



\[Gameplay Improvements] New Features 

Tutorial mode for newcomer guidance,

Backfill system: automatic player replacement for leavers,

Vaulting action: enhanced strategic positioning through obstacle traversal,

 Communication Systems 

In-game voice chat,

Smart ping system: context-aware ping functionality,

Waypoint marking for precise team coordination,

 Control Enhancements 

Improved camera controls,

Enhanced crouched enemy targeting for better accessibility,

 Immersion Features 

Announcer and character voice additions,

Enhanced situational awareness and gameplay immersion,



\[Map Updates] New Map 

'Yacht' map: spacious layout with irregular structures for diverse playstyles,

\[Map Design Changes] 

 Major 'Hospital' Map Renewal 

New entry routes added for diversified attack paths,

Existing structures repositioned with new cover additions,

 Existing Map Improvements 

All maps adjusted to accommodate the new 'vaulting' system,

Cover positioning and height modifications for optimized movement flow,

 Visual Updates 

Shopping Mall map renewal,

Hospital map renewal,

Enhanced lighting and character rendering across all maps for improved graphics quality,



Enjoy the strategic and immersive gameplay with our newly enhanced systems! 

Feedback is always welcome. Have fun gaming!
